description: A revolving credit agreement between a borrower (issuer) and one or more lenders, with an administrative agent

agreement_title.description: The agreement's title as printed on the cover, e.g. 'Revolving Credit Agreement'

agreement_date.description: The date the agreement is made 'as of', from the opening paragraph, exactly as printed (e.g. "April 20, 2020")

copy_label.description: Any version label on the cover, such as 'Execution Copy'; null if none

borrower.description: The borrowing party (called the Issuer in some agreements)

name.description: The borrower's legal name, from the opening paragraph

entity_type.description: The kind of entity the opening paragraph says the borrower is, e.g. 'independent special district'

defined_term.description: The defined term the agreement uses for the borrower, e.g. 'Issuer' or 'Borrower'

enabling_law.description: The statute or act that governs or creates the borrower, as cited in the recitals

lenders.description: Each lender party named in the opening paragraph

defined_term.description: The defined term the agreement uses for this lender, e.g. 'Bank' or 'STI'

agent.description: The name of the party acting as agent for the lenders, from the opening paragraph

notes.description: The promissory notes that evidence borrowings under the agreement

full_name.description: The note's full name as defined in the agreement

tax_status.description: 'tax-exempt' or 'taxable', as the note's name states

maximum_commitment_amount.description: The initial Maximum Commitment Amount (the facility size), in USD

applicable_margin_basis_points.description: The Applicable Margin, in basis points (46 for 46 basis points)

benchmark_rate.description: The name of the floating benchmark rate interest is based on, e.g. 'LIBOR Rate'

unused_commitment_fee_basis_points.description: The unused commitment fee rate, in basis points

unused_fee_utilization_threshold_percent.description: The average utilization, as a percent of the Maximum Commitment Amount, below which the unused commitment fee applies

default_rate_spread_percent.description: The increase over the otherwise applicable rate that applies after an Event of Default, in percent per annum

maximum_lawful_rate_percent.description: The fixed percentage cap in the Maximum Lawful Rate definition

minimum_advance_amount.description: The minimum principal amount of each Advance, in USD

commitment_termination.description: How the Commitment Termination Date is determined, in a short phrase as defined

prior_credit_agreement.description: The earlier credit agreement this one refinances, if defined

description.description: The prior agreement's name and parties, as defined

date.description: The prior agreement's date, exactly as printed

governing_law.description: The law that governs the agreement, from the governing law section

venue.description: The court where the parties agree venue lies
